title: New Zealanders Demand Stronger Privacy Protections and Transparency
discussion_signal: The discussion highlights low confidence in privacy protections, strong demand for more say over information use, and AI-driven decision-making as a leading privacy concern. It connects formal rights with practical transparency and control.
linked_research_question: How does consumer protection shift from formal legal awareness toward practical rights knowledge, mediated advice, and successful recourse?
limits: The post summarizes a national privacy survey without exposing the complete questionnaire
Concern does not establish actual harm or successful redress
The discussion is New Zealand-specific and may not generalize across legal systems
